# Hospitals

This folder catalogs major hospital institutions providing psychiatric care and ADHD treatment in Denmark, specifically focusing on facilities in the Central Jutland region. It details the organizational structure of Aarhus University Hospital's psychiatry division and its specialized child and adolescent department, highlighting their clinical roles, key medical personnel, and their positioning within broader systemic challenges documented in national ADHD quality reports.

## Pages

- [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|"Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien"]] — The overarching psychiatric center housing child, youth, and adult psychiatric services, employing key figures in Danish ADHD treatment and operating against a backdrop of systemic regional challenges.
- [[bua|Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA)]] — A specialized child and adolescent psychiatric department operating within Aarhus University Hospital, serving as a central clinical reference center for ADHD assessment and treatment in children and youth.
